title: 第一卷 第20章 深林妖兽，巧取灵果
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
越往秘境腹地前行，林间林木愈发参天蔽日。

    浓郁的草木灵气混杂着淡淡的兽吼，在山谷间回荡。

    地面落满厚厚的腐叶，踩上去悄无声息，危机暗藏在每一片阴影之中。

    苏玄尘将气息压至最低，脚步沉稳，穿行在密林之间。

    他没有像其他弟子那般横冲直撞，而是借着古树与灌木丛掩护，目光扫过周遭每一处角落。

    极品天灵根不仅吸纳灵气神速，五感也远超常人。

    数丈之外的风吹草动、生灵吐息，皆清晰落入感知。

    前行片刻，一阵急促的喘息声与兵器碰撞声，自前方矮坡后传来。

    “吼！”

    低沉凶戾的兽啸震得树叶簌簌掉落。

    苏玄尘微微侧身，隐在一株千年古木之后，凝神观望。

    矮坡之下，一头半人高的青纹野狼，正死死缠住两名外门弟子。

    这是秘境常见的青纹妖狼，肉身强悍，爪牙锋利，修为约莫炼气四层。

    两名弟子一男一女，皆是炼气三层。

    两人背靠背防守，手中短刃翻飞，脸色早已发白。

    汗水顺着额角不断滑落，灵力消耗巨大，招式渐渐散乱。

    “撑不住了！这妖狼皮糙肉厚，灵力攻击收效甚微！”

    男弟子声音带着慌张，手臂已被狼爪划开数道血痕。

    女弟子面色煞白，环顾四周：“此处偏僻，根本无人前来搭手，再这样下去，我们都要葬身狼口！”

    青纹妖狼眼中凶光暴涨，四肢蹬地，身躯如一道青色残影猛扑而出。

    腥臭劲风扑面而来，锋利獠牙直取两人脖颈。

    两人避无可避，眼中露出绝望之色。

    就在这千钧一发之际。

    一道苍老身影，自树后缓步走出。

    “孽畜，退下。”

    声音平淡，却带着一股历经岁月的沉凝。

    青纹妖狼动作骤然一顿，转头看向苏玄尘。
content_en:
The further you go towards the hinterland of the secret realm, the trees in the forest become more and more towering and block out the sun.

    The rich aura of vegetation mixed with the faint roar of beasts echoed in the valley.

    The ground is covered with thick rotten leaves, which make no sound when stepped on. Crisis is hidden in every shadow.

    Su Xuanchen suppressed his breath to the lowest level and walked steadily through the dense forest.

    He did not run rampant like other disciples, but took advantage of the cover of ancient trees and bushes to scan every corner around him.

    The top-grade Tianling Root not only absorbs spiritual energy very quickly, but also has five senses far beyond those of ordinary people.

    The movement of wind and grass and the breathing of creatures a few feet away are all clearly perceived.

    After walking forward for a moment, a sound of rapid breathing and the sound of weapons clashing came from behind the short slope in front.

    "Roar!"

    The low and ferocious roar of the beast made the leaves rustle and fall.

    Su Xuanchen turned slightly sideways, hiding behind a thousand-year-old tree, and watched intently.

    Under the short slope, a blue-striped wild wolf half as tall as a man was clinging to two outer disciples.

    This is a blue-patterned demon wolf that is common in secret realms. It has a strong body and sharp claws. Its cultivation level is about the fourth level of Qi Refining.

    The two disciples, one male and one female, are both at the third level of Qi Refining.

    The two of them defended back to back, their short blades flying in their hands, their faces already turning pale.

    Sweat continued to fall down his forehead, his spiritual power was consumed a lot, and his moves gradually became scattered.

    "I can't hold on any longer! This demonic wolf has rough skin and thick flesh, and its spiritual attack has little effect!"

    The male disciple's voice was panicked, and his arm had been cut with several bloody marks by the wolf's claws.

    The female disciple turned pale and looked around: "This place is remote and no one comes to help. If this continues, we will all die!"

    The fierce light in the blue-striped demon wolf's eyes suddenly surged, its limbs kicked off the ground, and its body swooped out like a blue afterimage.

    The smelly wind blew in their faces, and the sharp fangs went straight to the necks of the two men.

    The two of them could not avoid it, with despair in their eyes.

    At this critical moment.

    An old figure slowly walked out from behind the tree.

    "You evil beast, step back."

    The voice was calm, but it carried a calmness that had gone through the years.

    The blue-striped demon wolf suddenly stopped and turned to look at Su Xuanchen.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 20 Monsters in the deep forest, cleverly harvesting spiritual fruits
